Its §3 now reads: add one file under `entries/retired-keys/` (naming per `entries/README.md`), then run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry`, ⛔ never type in `registry.ts`. Per the triage split, whichever lands second quotes the first.
